policy_schema.principle: Named district/county-equivalent or coherent city territory, with named physical geography for anonymous remote census coverage. No count targets or mean-area selection. Country-specific source roles and individual outliers require review.

countries.assessment: A whole Falkland archipelago aggregates East Falkland, West Falkland and offshore islands. Official government pages were retrieved but no complete licensed island inventory was established here. Named-island subdivision is a research proposal, not a split justified by disconnected geometry alone.
remaining_required_reviews: Independent purpose/settlement/physical evidence for every local territory
Exact original source coverage, source vintage and license suitability
Individually justified flagged cases, including all islands and urban envelopes
Every higher-tier boundary and complete member union

countries.assessment: The single active territory includes South Georgia and the separate South Sandwich chain. The government explicitly identifies eleven South Sandwich volcanic islands 350–500 miles southeast of South Georgia. This challenges a single local-territory purpose; splitting requires exact licensed named-archipelago footprints and original coverage, not a centroid-based cut.
